SAP ABAP AI Utilisation, Productivity Improvement & Delivery Efficiency Report
PAL  |  ONGC (OVL)  |  Astral (KPMG)      20 July - 19 November 2026      Arnav Johri, Associate Consultant (SAP ABAP), Diligent Global
1. Executive Summary

From July to November 2026 AI (Claude Code) became part of my daily SAP ABAP delivery on three projects running at the same time: PAL, ONGC Videsh (OVL) and Astral through KPMG. It covered the full cycle - reading FS documents and legacy code, building new objects, correcting existing ones, ATC remediation, root-cause analysis of production dumps and writing technical specifications.

The result is a body of work that would normally take a larger team: complete applications (CDS / RAP dashboards, an approval workflow, a forecasting system), reports, interfaces, enhancements and tools - 312 custom SAP objects in all. Every object was reviewed, activated and tested by me before go-live.

blocks.text: 3. How AI Was Used in Daily Delivery
The same five-step loop ran on every project:

items: **Intake** - issue mail, FS or change request triaged into a queue.
**Fresh source** - current version downloaded from SAP (ZR_PROG_DOWNLOAD / SE80) and compared with the last copy, so no one else's change is lost.
**AI build or diagnosis** - Claude Code reads the source, the dump or the trace and writes the corrected or new object, with change markers and the old code kept commented.
**Activation and test** - I paste or import the object, activate it, feed activation errors back, and test with the functional consultant.
**Record** - issue, cause and fix logged per object and committed, so every change is traceable.

blocks.text: 8. ATC Correction and Code Optimisation Summary
ATC S/4HANA-readiness remediation for ONGC was worked family by family, so each correction pattern was derived once and reused across the batch (64 h conventional, 57 h with AI).

blocks.caption: Main finding types and the correction applied
rows: NOORDER - SELECT SINGLE possibly not unique
Rebuild as SELECT <f> FROM <t> WHERE <c> ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY INTO @tgt UP TO 1 ROWS. ENDSELECT. - strip SINGLE; on a projection ORDER BY the selected key fields.
NOORDER - READ ... BINARY SEARCH without SORT
Insert SORT itab BY <WITH KEY fields> before the enclosing LOOP (dedupe identical SORT).
CONV #( ) to the MATNR / amount type or retype the variable to the field's data element, then #EC CI_FLDEXT_OK[note] as resolution marker.
Read V_VBUK_S4 / V_VBUP_S4 in strict Open SQL, or the status fields on VBAK/VBAP/LIKP/LIPS; LIKPUK -> I_DeliveryDocument.
FROM v_konv / v_konv_cds in strict Open SQL, drop CLIENT SPECIFIED and mandt.
Field-aliased SELECT from the CDS (element AS bseg field), absolute-amount elements plus SHKZG, strict SQL; SELECT * / ENDSELECT / UP TO stay on BSEG with #EC...
FROM table-name swap plus TYPE retype. Labelled a cipla disposition and 'gated' in HO section 8, yet 34 August blocks in the OVL files apply J_1IMOVEND -> LFA1.
Worked example MSC1 -> BAPI_BATCH_CREATE (+ BAPI_OBJCL_GETDETAIL / _CREATE, COMMIT, BAPIRET2 -> bdcmsgcoll); XK01 -> VMD_EI_API, VA01 -> BAPI_SALESORDER_CREATEFROMDAT2.
Rewrite to Open SQL where practical, else #EC CI_EXECSQL.
CLIENT SPECIFIED on a compatibility view
Drop CLIENT SPECIFIED and the mandt condition; leave it on real transparent tables.
Comma-separated field and ORDER BY lists, @ on right-hand operands only, clause order FROM - FAE - WHERE - ORDER BY - INTO - UP TO.
IF driver IS NOT INITIAL around every FOR ALL ENTRIES.

blocks.text: 10. Quantified Effort and Productivity Analysis

blocks.caption: ONGC carries most of the volume; every project shows a clear saving.

blocks.text: **Method.** Effort without AI = conservative baseline for the work type and complexity of each use case. Actual effort with AI = all my working time in the period (69 days from 19/08/26 including 6 weekend days, plus dated work before), spread over the use cases by measured session time and size. Saved = without - with; man-days = saved / 8; reduction = saved / without. Every number is formula-driven in the attached Excel register.
11. Development Quality and Delivery Improvement
Development efficiency

items: Working versions the same or next working day - ZMM_BP_CREATE_MAIL built and activated on first paste the day the FS answers arrived; Paints forecast from FS (19/10) to active (22/10).
Reuse instead of rework - forecast engine reused for Paints, GL workflow class reused for the FB70 workflow, MB5B amount logic ported to ZMM_MB5B_NEW.

CJ88 and FBV0 posting errors proven to sit in SAP standard from ST22 / SM13 / ST05 evidence - no custom code touched; PAL INC01967 unreadable PDFs traced to the encryption round trip and closed.

blocks.text: 12. Customer Benefits

items: **Capacity released** - one associate consultant carried three projects, ATC remediation and production support in the same months.

blocks.text: 13. Strongest AI Success Story - ONGC JIB Status Dashboard

rows: Management Dashboard 'JIB Status' - ZFI_JIB_STATUS: cube ZI_JIB_STATUS_CUBE with seven supporting CDS views
For every joint venture: is the period's JIB posted and when was it entered, by month, quarter or fiscal year, with document drill-down, as a Fiori Custom Analytical Query.
No venture on the document header; JIB identified by document type from a GS01 set; reversals; empty months shown as Pending; older S/4 CDS release; delivery by abapGit ZIP.
SE16N data analysis, view-by-view design by trial activation, a rebuild after each client test.
Read the requirement workbook and production samples, designed the data model, wrote all eight views and the ZIP, rebuilt the model on each round of client feedback.
Document-type set confirmed in GS03 / SE16N; each version imported, activated and checked against production documents; client tests relayed; launchpad navigation set.
Requirement 03/11/26 -> first query running 04/11 -> client test 06/11 -> navigation 12/11 -> written client confirmation 17/11 (11 working days, four additions included).
42 h conventional -> 21 h with AI: 21 h saved, 50% less effort.
Corporate Accounts, 17/11/26: 'working well and meeting expectations'.
The same cube pattern now serves Bank Revaluation, the Treasury bank register and Per-Barrel analysis.

blocks.text: 14. Overall Conclusions

items: AI is part of how I deliver: faster first builds and faster root-cause analysis, with every object reviewed, activated and tested by me.
The approach is repeatable - the same loop and toolkit worked on PAL, ONGC and Astral, across reports, CDS / RAP, workflow, enhancements and ATC.
Next steps: share the AI delivery toolkit with the team, reuse the dashboard pattern for further cards, apply the ATC patterns to the next remediation wave.
